name: Adventure Modpack
summary: The optional client pack for the 26.3 server: shaders, Distant Horizons, maps, animations and sounds. Nothing in it is needed to join.
_comment: This manifest is the source for build-modpack.sh when the selected version is 26.3 (mc_manifest in scripts/lib.sh). The 'files' array is populated at build time from the client mod list below. The in-house companion (mods/client-mods-26.3.manifest) rides in overrides/mods/.

_clientMods._comment: Modrinth slugs of the optional 26.3 client pack: the register's kept client and optional rows (docs/design/rebuild-26/mod-register.csv) and the libraries they need. An unmodded client joins without any of them (decisions.md RB-02); each is presentation only (RB-03, RB-25). build-modpack.sh resolves these to download URLs and populates 'files'.
_clientMods._stableOnlyComment: stableOnly: resolver picks the newest RELEASE for these slugs instead of the newest build of any channel. Use for mods whose pre-release channels have burned us. Everything else gets the newest build - mod authors keep their own latest sets coherent (e.g. supplementaries release requires sodium beta).
_clientMods._parityExemptComment: _parityExempt: slugs check-client-parity.py must not fail on, keyed by slug with the reason. A server mod declaring client_side=required that genuinely ships no client registry entries belongs here. Remove an entry only when its stated reason stops being true.
_clientMods._holdsComment: holds: slugs pin-mod-versions.sh must NOT re-pin, keyed by slug with the reason. Remove an entry only when its blocker clears.

_waitingComment: _waiting: register rows (decision waiting) that join the pack when their author ships a 26.3 build (decisions.md RB-09), keyed by slug with the list they join.

_shaderPacks._comment: Modrinth shader packs, pinned as slug:versionId.

_resourcePacks._comment: Modrinth resource packs. Pinned as slug:versionId (like _clientMods) so builds are reproducible and weekly updates don't silently change filenames. An entry may also be an object {slug: 'slug:vid', files: [...]} for named companion files. pin-mod-versions.sh re-pins on --apply. Packs are ENABLED by filename in overrides/configureddefaults/options.txt; the build points each entry at the downloaded file of the same pack with its new version, and fails only when an enabled pack has no such download. A re-pin stays on the pinned style variant (os-colorful-grasses publishes Short, Tall, Mix... as separate versions).

packs._comment: Human villagers/illagers/zombies via EMF+ETF (CC-BY-SA-4.0, by BishopMCNuggets). FreshAni Activator makes it drive Fresh Animations.
